bio: This lovely restaurant with its delightful terrace overlooking the garden serves regional and seasonal cuisine with the odd nod to international culinary traditions. A friendly and well-drilled front-of-house team help to create an inviting atmosphere. Tip: If you want to be close to the action, book the Chef's Table in the kitchen ( minimum 6 people). And if you wish to spend a little longer here, Hotel Engel Obertal offers comfortable, stylish guestrooms and fantastic facilities to help make your stay a relaxing one....
